status_rule.real: handler has real logic and librs issues the call
status_rule.stub: handler returns a constant, TODO, or -1 without doing work (Nop's stub is intended: a no-op syscall returns 0)
status_rule.noop: handler is real but the librs method returns Ok(()) without calling
status_rule.missing: not dispatched, no handler, or librs does not expose the call
